model.target: Observed low/medium-to-high pasture-vigour transition from 2023 to 2024; initial pasture candidates include exits to non-pasture as non-improvements.
model.scope: Statutory Legal Amazon (IBGE 2024); 1-km systematic sample. Retrospective conditional probabilities, not a causal effect or a validated forecast beyond 2024.
model.validation: 100-km blocks: 60% training, 20% calibration, 20% untouched test; fixed seed 2026. Spatial autocorrelation may extend beyond blocks.
model.vintages: Initial vigour and high-vigour distance 2023; roads/silos 2021; export eligibility through June 2024; rainfall 2020–2024; recent forest conversion through 2023.
model.adaptation: Open gradient-boosting re-estimation inspired by Barreto et al. (2025); not a replication of its TerrSet MLP, calibration horizon, or 13-predictor model.
model.plant_scope: 71 of 72 listed China/Hong Kong plants geocoded by SIF; all 31 China-licensed plants matched. SIF 455 missing; never imputed.
